headline: Micron advertises full-chip AMS verification with AI-agent development and output evaluation
fact: Micron advertised October 5 LinkedIn role JR113919 for block-to-full-chip AMS verification, power-loss/brownout checks and agents for requirements-to-test extraction, triage, failure clustering, waveform guidance and coverage gaps. Related official JR114263, dated October 8, adds behavioral/schematic models accurate enough for each verification objective. Both require validated engineering data, human review and evaluation of AI-output usefulness and limitations. Preferred experience measures reduced manual effort, faster debug, traceability or verification completeness; these are evaluation criteria, not reported improvements. The distinct requisitions are grouped as an advertised development mandate.

sources.title: Micron: SR, Engineer - AMS Verification, JR113919 — employer LinkedIn posting
sources.summary: Employer-attributed full job description and JobPosting metadata identify JR113919 and October 5, 2026 as the LinkedIn posting date. The official Careers first-publication date is not established. This is a distinct requisition from the March JR93301 AI-assisted-coding role.

sources.title: Micron Careers: SR, Engineer – AMS Verification (JR114263)
sources.summary: Official Workday startDate remains October 8, 2026. Full duties specify objective-appropriate model accuracy and evaluated agent prototypes. Benefit measurement is preferred experience, not demonstrated gains; final verification decisions remain grounded in simulation, specifications and engineering judgment.
